hints.title: Identify Minimum Price Threshold
hints.text: Find the minimum ball value threshold T such that selling all balls priced above T meets or exceeds orders.

hints.title: Sum Arithmetic Progressions
hints.text: For each ball pile with count greater than T, sum the arithmetic series from T + 1 to the count.

hints.title: Add Remaining Balls at Threshold
hints.text: Sell the remaining difference of orders at exactly price T.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, inventory: list[int], orders: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        lo, hi = 0, max(inventory)
        threshold = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            total_sold = sum(max(0, x - mid) for x in inventory)
            if total_sold <= orders:
                threshold = mid
                hi = mid - 1
            else:
                lo = mid + 1
        profit = 0
        sold = 0
        for x in inventory:
            if x > threshold:
                cnt = x - threshold
                profit = (profit + (threshold + 1 + x) * cnt // 2) % MOD
                sold += cnt
        rem = orders - sold
        profit = (profit + rem * threshold) % MOD
        return profit
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation with a heap decrements one by one, exceeding time limits for orders = 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on the final threshold takes logarithmic iterations with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should formulate the binary search over price threshold and use closed-form arithmetic series sums.
